threads.body: [General] This still leaves the other no-database case from the referenced discussion broken: for `jdbc:mysql:host`, `portLoc == -1` and `dbLoc == -1`, so the `else` branch assigns `hostEndLoc = -1` and `substring(...)` throws. The outer parser swallows that failure and returns the default host instead of `host`. Use the effective end position in both branches (and cover this host-only form in the regression data).
